notes.title: v1.0.3 Update - Performance Improvements + Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Small performance improvements which should result in smoother frame rates.
[*] Fixed a couple of potentially game breaking bugs.
[*] Fixed a couple of small visual UI issues.
[*] Added common Chinese characters to UI fonts, meaning most player names written with Chinese characters should appear correctly in game, such as on leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Update - Improved Leaderboards + Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved leaderboards to include every player who has made at least 1 attempt, ordered by highest altitude reached. Previously only best completion times were shown. Go to "Rankings" from the in-game menu to see your global rank!
[*] Added partial support for Nintendo Switch Pro controllers. These controllers do not have analog triggers so aren't as well supported as Xbox/PlayStation, but appropriate button prompts will now be shown.
[*] Improved support for generic gamepads not recognised as Xbox/PlayStation/Switch controllers.
[*] Fixed errors related to playing while not connected to Steam.
[*] Fixed an issue where the recorded value for fuel used in an attempt was lower than it should be.
[/list]
